enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Dread Root
descriptions: Melee attacks can root their victim, allowing allies to close in.
enemies.behavior: Accepted attacks make the ranked root roll and publish the timed root lifecycle.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals damaged allies; roots heroes and calls nearby friends to focus them.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Distracted Mongrel
descriptions: Fast melee attacker that is easily distracted.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered fast melee cadence includes the exact one-percent distraction delay.

enemies.name: Stealth Slayer
descriptions: Appears from stealth beside heroes, then fights in melee.
enemies.behavior: It spawns stealthed, reveals on its first accepted attack or hit, and pursues into close melee.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long-range necro projectiles and heals when nearby allies take damage.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile is unchanged and every committed nearby allied hit now heals it for a bounded fraction of that damage.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Stealths to close distance; melee causes future Physical vulnerability.
enemies.behavior: Stealth Attack closes from range and its follow-up melee applies the hit-count vulnerability.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a sleeping cloud, then closes for a melee swipe.

enemies.name: Pyro
descriptions: Short-range fire breath can hit multiple targets.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.
